pages.desc: Steep indoor bouldering terrain, four monthly-reset climbing zones, tension loft, and transparent drop-in passes in Portland.
pages.name: Home
pages.title: Kairn Climbing — Indoor Bouldering & Training Gym

props.text: Portland Pearl District · 14,500 Sq Ft Bouldering
Steep limestone terrain, reset every Tuesday.

props.html: Ninety-four hand-stripped problems across four climbing angles, paired with a tension board loft, finger-strength rung station, and quiet recovery sauna.

props.alt: Climber working a steep basalt bouldering wall dusted in white chalk
Interior of Kairn Climbing 45-degree overhanging birch and basalt arch cave with crash mats
props.caption: The North Arch — 45° continuous roof into vertical top-out mantle.

props.html: Mat Depth: 32 cm triple-density closed-cell foam across the entire perimeter, inspected weekly for seam tension and fall-zone clearance.

props.text: Four terrain zones stripped and re-textured every month.

props.html: Thuggy roof pulls linked into heel-hook bicycles on custom geometric birch volumes.
North-lit delicate balance sets built for smearing precision, gaston transitions, and quiet feet.
Sixteen-foot tall dynamic coordination climbs mixing glossy fiberglass scoops with sandpaper crimps.
Full hydraulic 16×12 board beside calibrated 18mm/20mm hangboards, kettlebells, and wooden rings.

props.text: Simple rates with zero initiation fees.

props.html: Month-to-month memberships include unlimited training loft access, Tuesday setter talks, and one guest pass every billing cycle.
Full access to all boulder zones, Kilter loft, and locker showers.
Resoled climbing shoes plus washable liquid chalk pouch for the day.
Shareable across household members, valid for twenty-four months.
No contract freeze penalty, one guest pass per month, and sauna access.
Weekday early sessions for shift workers, freelancers, and students.
Early morning strength sessions open six-thirty sharp; rotated zone strips stay isolated so the rest of the floor never closes.
Address & Gear Check: 918 NW 15th Ave, Bay 4 · Covered bike lockers, showers & cedar sauna included
First-Time Visitors: Plan fifteen minutes early for shoe fitting and our five-minute mat orientation.
